title: Electronic Billboard
body:
"Displays an image depending on what the input signal is. The signal input has to be a Roblox image ID. An easy way to input this number is with a number interface."

The Electronic Billboard is a structure that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It accepts a logic signal to display any decal uploaded to Roblox.

Functionality

When placed, the Electronic Billboard has a size of 2×2×1, and displays nothing. The Electronic Billboard can be resized up to 15×15×1, and down to 1×1×1.

The Electronic Billboard has a single input port on its back side. The signal sent to the Electronic Billboard will be interpreted as a decal ID; this makes a Number Interface a requirement. The image displayed by the Electronic Billboard, unlike a Painting, is not affected by lighting and always displays at full brightness.
